_note: Read 17 September 2026 from prestigeone.ae. No form was filled - the site's 'Register for interest' and the /project-documents page ask for name, email and phone, and I did not touch them. Two families of image are excluded as page furniture, not project media: /assets/images/v3/amenities-sliders/... which are stock views of Dubai landmarks (Burj Khalifa, Palm Jumeirah, the airport) used as a location strip on every project page, and /assets/project-featured-images/sliders/... which are thumbnail cards advertising OTHER projects at the foot of the page. Every render on this site carries a PRESTIGE ONE watermark. 2B+G+5+ROOF, studio to 3-bedroom, a low-rise in a classical English idiom. I downloaded and LOOKED at all four gallery images and the featured image. FILENAME WARNING: three of the four gallery files are labelled 'Night' but two of them are plainly not night scenes - the courtyard pool view and the pool retreat view both read as bright daylight or early evening under a blue sky. Treat the word Night in these names as unreliable. No floor plans are published as images.
